name: Feestdagen Caribisch Nederland (Bonaire, Saba, Sint Eustatius) — compleet, 4 talen (2011–2030)
title: Feestdagen Caribisch Nederland (Bonaire, Saba, Sint Eustatius) — compleet, 4 talen (2011–2030)
description: Comprehensive Caribbean Netherlands (BES — Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba) national public holidays 2011-2030, in all 4 vacanza-supported languages: Dutch (nl), Papiamento BES dialect (pap_BQ), English BES variant (en_BQ), English US (en_US). Each (date, category) pair is one record, multilingual names as columns. The BES islands became special municipalities of the Netherlands on 10 October 2010 after the dissolution of the Netherlands Antilles; vacanza BES start_year=2011 (first full year as openbaar lichaam). This is the NATIONAL/federal baseline — see also nl-bonaire-feestdagen, nl-saba-feestdagen, nl-sint-eustatius-feestdagen for the three per-island subdivision splits that add island-specific holidays (Rincondag/Bonairedag for Bonaire, Sabadag/Dag-na-Carnaval for Saba, Emancipatiedag/Statiadag for Sint Eustatius).
